notes.title: Pride
notes.notes: [p]❤️🧡💛💚💙💜[/p][p][/p][p]Here in Manchester UK, celebrations of the LGBTQ+ community are loud and proud across the city from 15th to 25th August 2025. notes.title: Three Year Anniversary
notes.notes:
Three years ago today, I accomplished something I will be proud of for the rest of my life: I released Dear Agony Aunt <3

While a lot of love and effort went into this project, I am aware that it is a small game. Steam has an absurdly vast stock of games that offer more hours of gameplay than this one can. So, now that Dear Agony Aunt has reached the grand old age of three years old, I've made the decision to reduce the price.
The base price in USD has changed: $4.99 -> $3.99
In sterling that is: £4.29 -> £3.39
I am trusting the equivalent prices suggested by Valve for all other currencies.

Thank you for sticking around <3

Faye <3x

notes.title: Steam Awards 2022
notes.notes:
The Steam Awards 2022 have begun!

This year, Dear Agony Aunt received a major update on its one year anniversary. Every single character in the game had their story edited, expanded or even completely rewritten. And I added a new spam email!

This game will always mean the world to me. Making it and continuing to support it has been a true labour of love, and I hope to carry on pouring love into it and see it grow. After all, what is worth your time more than the things you love?

It would mean an awful lot to me if you would nominate Dear Agony Aunt for the Labor Of Love award <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218772/e15eb1f81ae3dde9f088406a7bd6a92719bc12a6.jpg[/img]

At this time, on this day, one year ago, Dear Agony Aunt was released!

Over the past few months, I've been busy working on story updates for every single character in the game. You'll find minor changes for some, substantial edits for others and even a couple of complete rewrites. What are they? It's a mystery! :D

Faye <3x

notes.title: Six Months
notes.notes:
There is a lot of exciting news to share with you today ^^

On Friday 1st April 2022, Dear Agony Aunt will turn six months old! (Already?!) And of course a half anniversary celebration means a half price sale.

Those of you who already own the game may have noticed that it updated today. Dear Agony Aunt was complete the day it was released, but I've been working on some story updates for you and the first six were added to the game today. These updates are just for fun, to add a little more to the characters' personalities, or to tell you a little more about their lives or their predicaments. The intention with this content update is to enrich what is already there and to allow you to get to know each of the characters even better.

Steam's Simfest event coincides with Dear Agony Aunt's half anniversary celebration. Simfest is all about making hard work fun and giving gamers the chance to try out careers they may otherwise never have the opportunity to experience. I'm thrilled to announce that Dear Agony Aunt is participating in this event!

Faye <3x

notes.title: Release Day
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Dear Agony Aunt community :)

The development process for Dear Agony Aunt has been a whirlwind of excitement and stress and amazement. I can't believe release day is already here!

If you'd like to read about my experience of making the game, I wrote a post about the Dear Agony Aunt development adventure on my blog:
[url=https://fayestrawberry.wordpress.com/2021/10/01/dear-agony-aunt-out-now/]Faye Strawberry blog[/url]

Thank you so much for taking an interest in the game. I hope you enjoy getting to know the characters and trying to convince EF Magazine that you would be a great choice as their new agony aunt!

Faye <3x
